entries.exactBehavior: Options > tag suggestions opens an explicit owner-held draft with independent ordered search/result namespace tables. Namespace then weight questions append one colon, reject empty/colon catch-alls and duplicate slices, preserve exact warnings, accept 0..10000, allow catch-all weight edits but protect them from deletion, retain selected row identity and enable Edit only for one row. Question/child/parent Cancel discards the corresponding edits; child Apply only stages; parent Apply atomically saves changed weights and preserves live unrelated related preferences. Reopen restores persisted tables. Saved weights reach an already-open local Manage Tags related list, where independent search/result weighting, binary64 truncation, sibling-ideal deduplication, storage/display and local/all-known distinctions match fresh bounded actual Qt cases. Activation only adds missing tags to the captured files. Namespace and numeric-weight headers use Python casefold/full-row tie-breaks in both directions, preserving stable equal keys and selected namespace identity. Each table retains independent selection and sort direction across the native view selector; Add replaces prior selection with the new namespace, matching Qt.
